summary: Tested (1) 50MB upload size (5/10/20MB dummy PDFs + real DOCX extraction) and (2) admin purge users endpoint (guard + happy path + role check). Also validated the frontend two-step purge dialog gating with exact type-to-confirm. 9/9 backend tests passed in 57.67s. Frontend double-confirm UI gating works (initial disabled, partial disabled, lowercase disabled, exact phrase enables, trailing space disables).
action_items: Main agent should restore seed data (students/parents/teachers + attempts) from /app/tests/_users_backup.json after this run as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_user endpoint allows any authenticated user to fetch another user's record by id (only /users list is admin-guarded); consider restricting to admin or self.

purge endpoint uses db.users.find/delete with to_list(1000000) and $in list, which is fine for current scale but if user count ever gets very large consider batching to avoid document size issues on $in.
test_credentials: admin@examnest.io / Admin@123 / role=admin (login API returns `token`, not `access_token`).
seed_data_creation: None. Backend happy-path PURGED all non-admin users as instructed; main agent to restore from /app/tests/_users_backup.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response field is `token`. Admin role must be selected via tab (not combobox) on /login. Users page is /admin/students. All data-testid attributes present and functional on AdminStudents.jsx. The purge test is destructive — main agent restores seed afterwards.
